h: Mercy Aigbe shows off baby bump, husband Kazim Adeoti confirms with sweet post
p: Actress Mercy Aigbe has shared photos of her baby bump, and her husband Kazim Adeoti has reposted them with a warm message, putting speculation to rest. The 48-year-old is expecting her third child.
body: Nollywood actress Mercy Aigbe is expecting a baby, after sharing photos of her growing baby bump on Instagram.

The 48-year-old mother of two posted the photos with a caption about a journey beginning with a little heartbeat and changing the course of a lifetime. It will be her third child, and her first with her husband, film producer Kazim Adeoti.

Some fans had initially suspected the post was a prank or stunt. However, Kazim Adeoti shared the same photos on his own Instagram page on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, with a heartfelt message about motherhood, which many took as confirmation.
Fans and colleagues flooded both posts with congratulations, with some adding humorous comments about the surprise announcement.
more: She is expecting her third child.
